title: API credential cardset + live stream canvas for SDK quickstarts
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Deliver a compact, reusable visual asset pack for API/SDK quickstarts focused on three paired patterns: 1) credential cardset — small digestible cards that teach API key creation, rotation, and scoped tokens; 2) live stream canvas — lightweight animated frames that show streaming output states, incremental tokens, and cancel/reconnect flows; 3) tool-calling mockups — structured response examples and callouts for function/tool invocation UX. Assets must include light/dark variants, mobile and desktop screenshot crops, and a static sprite + animated Lottie for the streaming indicator. The goal is to reduce doc reading time by surfacing how-to steps in visual chunks while remaining copy-light and production-ready for release docs and the SDK quickstart pages.
acceptance_criteria: Credential cards (3 variants) exported as SVG + PNG at 1x/2x with copy editable in Figma
Streaming canvas: three frames (idle, receiving tokens, reconnect) exported as Lottie + MP4 + PNG poster
Tool-calling mockups: two API response variants (success + schema error) in screenshot-size-ready assets
Accessible color contrast verified for both light and dark themes (WCAG AA for text >= 14px)
All assets documented in design handoff doc with CSS snippets, export naming, and suggested alt text
Engineering has at least one reference screenshot + storybook-ready component examples linked in PR
